title: Student V0.1 — Activity Experience Lab V1
purpose: Build an isolated fail-fast Activity Experience Lab that consumes learner-safe ActivityPresentation fixtures, prototypes richer interactions, emits exact frozen ActivityResponse shapes, and stops for explicit human prototype selection before any production presenter implementation.
invariants: The Lab is outside the production Learn-it app and must not modify production presenters in this job.
Fixtures are learner-safe ActivityPresentation only and may not contain hidden scoring authority.
The Lab never computes or displays correctness.
The Lab never decides mastery, objective progress, session progression or completion.
Each prototype emits only the frozen response grammar for its family.
No plugin registry, dynamic loader, evaluator callback framework or event bus is introduced.
Richer drag/spatial interactions always retain keyboard and touch-safe non-drag operation.
Animation is progressive enhancement and respects reduced-motion.
Human micro-review is mandatory before a variant can be selected for future production integration.
Phase B records human variant selection only; it still does not modify production presenters.
RESULT_SHA binds Lab implementation/tests before any human selection; LAB_SELECTION_SHA is a later selection-only commit.
requiredEvidence: Fresh HCP/main/common-base authority and exact contract-authority blob verification.
Architecture note documenting the Lab boundary and non-goals.
Path-aware secret scan proving fixtures contain none of correctChoiceId, fill answers, acceptedResponses, matches, correctOrder or authored classify assignments.
Deterministic static Lab artifact and local-only/network-free operation.
Fixture coverage for lesson, flashcard, matching, order, classify, qcm and fill.
At least two meaningfully different variants each for flashcard, matching, order and classify.
At least one simplified lesson candidate and polished qcm/fill baselines.
Response inspector proving exact ActivityResponse shape from each prototype without correctness.
Keyboard tests for every prototype variant.
Mobile/touch layout/interaction tests for every variant.
Screen-reader/accessibility smoke for every candidate interaction pattern.
Deterministic human review bundle with bundle hash/bytes and variant manifest.
Repository governance PASS and exact changed-path scope PASS.
Phase B selection file accepted only from explicit human form with exact bundle hash.
adversarialTests: Fail if any fixture contains correctChoiceId, acceptedResponses, authored matches, correctOrder, fill answer key or classify solution assignments.
Fail if any prototype calls product scoring/evaluation code or invents correctness.
Fail if drag-and-drop is the only way to operate matching/order/classify.
Fail if a prototype cannot emit the exact frozen response shape.
Fail if Lab code imports production session/progress/persistence authority.
Fail if production activity_presenters.js changes on this branch.
Fail if a human selection is inferred from comments rather than the explicit selection form.
Fail if a selected variant is implemented into production in this job.
independentReview: This Lab branch is authored independently from App Experience and Pilot Activity Policy streams.
It consumes only frozen contract documents and its own learner-safe fixtures, not sibling results.
Human selection occurs before any later production presenter implementation.
ATLAS-WP-054 will independently implement and qualify only the human-selected variants.
nonGoals: Constructed free-text prototyping for the first pilot.
rollback: Close the Stream B PR and delete student-v01/g5-r1-activity-experience-lab. No production code rollback is needed because the Lab is isolated.
